summary.headline: Shopify uses an app-based model where developers register apps via the Partner Dashboard and authenticate using OAuth 2.0.

difficulty_factors.reason: Requires a Shopify Partner account to register apps in the Dev Dashboard.
Apps for private use don't need review; public apps in the Shopify App Store must undergo a formal review process.
Review times for public apps vary and are not strictly published.
Developer accounts and access to Shopify APIs are free, with revenue sharing models for published apps.
Requires manual setup of a Partner account and creation of development stores.

setup_effort.estimate: 60-120 minutes for setup and initial auth flow implementation.

approval_wait.label: None for private apps; variable for App Store

can_start_today.reason: You can sign up for a Shopify Partner account and create an app in the Dev Dashboard immediately.

confidence.reason: Shopify official developer documentation is clear and accessible.

blockers.title: Shopify Partner Account Required
blockers.detail: All app development requires a registered Shopify Partner account.

steps.title: Create a Shopify Partner Account
steps.action: Sign up for a free Shopify Partner account to access the Dev Dashboard.
steps.why_human_only: Requires signing up for a business-related account and accepting terms.

steps.title: Register App in Dev Dashboard
steps.action: Navigate to the Partner Dashboard, create a new app, and configure your redirect URI.
steps.why_human_only: Requires access to the authenticated Partner Dashboard.

steps.title: Implement OAuth Flow
steps.action: Use the Shopify CLI or your preferred stack to implement OAuth 2.0 based on the official documentation.
steps.why_human_only: Requires writing custom code for the integration.

scopes.purpose: Read product data from the shop

common_rejection_reasons.reason: App UI not embedded correctly in Shopify Admin
common_rejection_reasons.fix: Ensure you are using the latest Shopify App Bridge libraries.

message_template.subject: Help integrating {{App_Name}} with Shopify
message_template.body: Hi, I am developing an integration for {{App_Name}} and have encountered an issue with {{Specific_Issue}}. I am following the official Shopify OAuth documentation. Could you please provide guidance on the correct implementation for this use case?

agent_did: Verified Shopify developer documentation exists and is accessible.
Confirmed Shopify uses OAuth 2.0 for app authentication.
agent_can_do_next: Draft boilerplate code for your OAuth implementation once you have your client credentials.

you_must.task: Create a Partner account and App entry.
you_must.reason: Only authorized users can access the dashboard to generate client IDs and secrets.

evidence.claim: Shopify requires Partner accounts to register apps, uses OAuth 2.0, and has specific paths for public and private apps.
evidence.source_note: Official portal for Shopify app development, scaffolding, and authentication.

tests.description: Confirm official developer documentation is accessible.
tests.observed: Status 200, returned scaffold instructions and links.
